subtitle: Wishing you the gentlest magic, sweetest wishes, and endless happiness.

specialReasons.title: Deep Empathy
specialReasons.desc: You listen with your whole heart and make everyone feel valued.

specialReasons.title: Free Spirit
specialReasons.desc: Your creative soul and gentle elegance make you truly one of a kind.

specialReasons.title: Calming Presence
specialReasons.desc: Being around you feels like a peaceful sanctuary of love and warmth.

letter.title: A Little Note For You
letter.content:
Sweet Sarah,

You have such a poetic, gentle soul that heals people just by being present. On your birthday, I pray that life returns all the kindness, love, and sweet dreams you give so freely to others.

Have the most enchanting birthday celebration ever!

With all my love,
Elena 💜🦋
